company.name: Nexus Health
company.description: Unified healthcare intelligence platform providing clinical decision support, insurance claims analytics, patient data management, and regulatory compliance tooling for hospitals and payers

departments.name: Technology
departments.description: Builds and maintains all software products and internal platforms

levels.title: Associate Engineer
levels.scope: Works on well-defined, scoped tasks under close supervision. Learns codebase and team practices. Rarely makes independent technical decisions.
levels.typical_background: New grad or intern transitioning to full-time

levels.title: Software Engineer
levels.scope: Owns individual features end-to-end. Coordinates with adjacent teams for integration. Makes implementation-level decisions independently.
levels.typical_background: 2-5 years industry experience, owns work independently

levels.title: Senior Engineer
levels.scope: Owns significant system components. Sets technical direction for features. Mentors junior engineers. Participates in design reviews across teams.
levels.typical_background: Seasoned engineer who drives quality and mentorship

levels.title: Staff Engineer
levels.scope: Drives technical direction for an entire team. Makes cross-team architecture decisions. Represents team in org-wide design forums. Owns multi-quarter technical roadmaps at team level.
levels.typical_background: Deep technical leader, often mistaken for engineering manager but stays IC

levels.title: Principal Engineer
levels.scope: Sets technical strategy across multiple teams or a full domain. Defines standards adopted org-wide. Frequent cross-org influence. Represents Nexus Health externally.
levels.typical_background: Rare technical voice with org-wide credibility

levels.title: Distinguished Engineer
levels.scope: Organization-wide technical impact. Defines patterns and architecture standards across all of engineering. External community presence expected (conference talks, open source contributions).
levels.typical_background: Recognized externally, defines the company's technical reputation

levels.title: Fellow
levels.scope: Defines multi-year technical bets for the organization. Advises CTO and executive leadership. Rare designation — fewer than 5 exist at any time at Nexus Health.
levels.typical_background: Exceptional individual who could be a CTO elsewhere

levels.title: Chief Architect
levels.scope: Most senior individual contributor. Reports directly to CTO. Owns the organization's entire technical architecture vision across all products and platforms.
levels.typical_background: One person in the organization

levels.title: Research Associate

levels.title: Principal Researcher
levels.scope: Defines the research agenda for a domain (e.g., clinical NLP, population health modeling). Strong publication record required. External advisory roles and grant authorship expected. Cross-org research strategy influence.

levels.title: Distinguished Researcher
levels.scope: Organization-wide research strategy. Defines Nexus Health's multi-year research direction. Externally recognized thought leader — keynote invitations, advisory boards, significant publication record.
levels.typical_background: Nationally or internationally recognized expert in their domain

levels.title: Junior Security Analyst
levels.scope: Alert triage, basic incident response, security tool monitoring under supervision.
levels.typical_background: Entry level, often from IT support or bootcamp with security certifications

levels.title: Security Analyst
levels.scope: Independent threat hunting and vulnerability scanning. Owns incident response for defined threat categories. Operates and tunes security tools.
levels.typical_background: 2-5 years security experience, usually CompTIA Security+ or similar

levels.title: Senior Security Analyst
levels.scope: Leads incident response for complex threats. Owns security tool procurement and configuration for a domain. Develops detection rules and playbooks.
levels.typical_background: CISSP or CISM holder, specialized in a security domain

levels.title: Security Engineer
levels.scope: Builds security tooling and integrates security controls into the engineering lifecycle. Automates security testing and remediation. Bridges security and engineering teams.
levels.typical_background: Software engineer who pivoted to security or security analyst with coding skills

levels.title: Senior Security Engineer
levels.scope: Designs security architecture for products and platforms. Leads security review for new system designs. Defines security standards for engineering teams.
levels.typical_background: Deep technical security professional with architecture experience

levels.title: Lead Security Engineer
levels.scope: Cross-organization security architecture leadership. Defines security standards adopted org-wide. Technical lead for major security programs.
levels.typical_background: Senior technical security leader with org-wide credibility

levels.title: Security Architect
levels.scope: Owns Nexus Health's entire security architecture vision. Defines zero-trust implementation strategy. Advises CISO on technical security direction. Cross-industry engagement.
levels.typical_background: Rare technical security expert, equivalent to L7 in engineering

levels.title: Chief Information Security Officer
levels.scope: Head of security organization. Reports to CEO. Board-level security accountability. Owns Nexus Health's entire security posture and regulatory compliance (HIPAA, SOC2, HITRUST).
levels.typical_background: CISO-level executive
